OEM heritage tables contain apparent errors:3200GT370km/h, BiturboS1983–1994 and inconsistent Ghibli displacement/code columns. Those values not copied.
A61500 top141km/h heritage versus150km/h anniversary release: speed null. Historic production counts also differ61/58: no production count/statistics invented.
Grecale GT launch sheet has width/track labelling error and consumption range; width and single consumption stay null.
MCPURA narrative torque720Nm versus table730Nm: null. OEM table kW/CV/hp consistency unresolved: powerKw null, no conversion. Premiere2025 not automatically SOP.
GT2 Stradale productionDecember2024 explicitly confirmed February2025 OEM release; April2025 sale is not substituted.
